94680847.description: APA-01, also known as PharmAla-1, is an entactogen of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families related to MDMA which is under development for potential medical use.

118984463.name: Insulin tregopil
118984463.description: Insulin tregopil is a fast-acting insulin analog which, unlike other forms of insulin, is delivered by mouth. It is developed by Biocon for diabetes.

124082063.name: BMS-466442
124082063.description: BMS-466442 is an experimental drug that acts as a selective inhibitor of the amino acid transporter alanine serine cysteine transporter-1 .

124518671.name: THJ-018
124518671.description: THJ-018 is a synthetic cannabinoid that is the indazole analogue of JWH-018 and has been sold online as a designer drug.

130449551.name: Nitromemantine
130449551.description: Nitromemantine (developmental code names YQW-36 and EM-036), also known as NitroSynapsin, is a derivative of memantine developed in 2006 for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

135413519.name: Lobucavir
135413519.description: Lobucavir (previously known as BMS-180194, Cyclobut-G) is an antiviral drug that shows broad-spectrum activity against herpesviruses, hepatitis B and other hepadnaviruses, HIV/AIDS and cytomegalovirus.

135426831.name: Oosporein
135426831.description: Oosporein is a toxic, bronze colored dibenzoquinone with the molecular formula C14H10O8.

135515151.name: Undecylprodigiosin
135515151.description: Undecylprodigiosin is an alkaloid produced by some Actinomycetes bacteria. It is a member of the prodiginines group of natural products and has been investigated for potential antimalarial activity.

139033615.name: Estriol phosphate
139033615.description: Estriol phosphate , or estriol 17β-phosphate, also known as estra-1,3,5 -triene-3,16α,17β-triol 17β- , is an estrogen which was never marketed.

139416847.name: Rocbrutinib

155884431.description: Nandrolone formate, also known as nandrolone carboxylate or nandrolone methanoate, as well as 19-nortestosterone 17β-formate or estr-4-en-17β-ol-3-one 17β-formate, is a synthetic, injected...

155927823.name: RTI-5152-12
155927823.description: RTI-5152-12, or WW-12 , is a synthetic small-molecule agonist of the atypical chemokine receptor ACKR3 that was derived from the naturally occurring alkaloid conolidine.

156012687.name: CTW0404
156012687.description: CTW0404 is an experimental drug which is described as a positive allosteric modulator of the 5-HT2A receptor, with neutral or negative modulation of the related 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C subtypes.

156735247.name: 2C-B-3PIP-POMe
156735247.description: 2C-B-3PIP-POMe is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, 3-phenylpiperidine , and NBOMe families.

165365647.name: FE-β-CPPIT
165365647.description: N- -3β- -2β- nortropane is a cocaine analogue.

347911311.name: Luspatercept
347911311.description: Luspatercept, sold under the brand name Reblozyl, is a medication used for the treatment of anemia in beta thalassemia and myelodysplastic syndromes.

900000015.name: 1T-AL-LAD
900000015.description: 1T-AL-LAD, also known as 1- -AL-LAD, is a psychedelic lysergamide derivative which has been sold as a designer drug, first reported in April 2024.

900000143.name: Amatuximab
900000143.description: Amatuximab is a chimeric monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer.

900000271.name: Beremagene geperpavec
900000271.description: Beremagene geperpavec, sold under the brand name Vyjuvek, is a gene therapy used for the treatment of wounds.

900000399.name: Californium(III) polyborate
900000399.description: Californium polyborate is a covalent compound with formula Cf[B6O8 5].

900000527.name: Curium hexafluoride
900000527.description: Curium hexafluoride is an inorganic chemical compound of curium and fluorine with the chemical formula CmF6.

900000655.name: Dupilumab
900000655.description: Dupilumab, sold under the brand name Dupixent, is a monoclonal antibody blocking interleukin 4 and interleukin 13 receptor signalling , used for allergic diseases such as atopic dermatitis , asthma...

900000783.name: Ethylene vinyl alcohol
900000783.description: Ethylene vinyl alcohol is a formal copolymer of ethylene and vinyl alcohol.

900000911.name: Guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride
900000911.description: Guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride is an organic compound that is a water-soluble quaternary ammonium derivative of guar gum.

900001039.name: Ipilimumab
900001039.description: Ipilimumab, sold under the brand name Yervoy, is a monoclonal antibody medication that works to activate the immune system by targeting CTLA-4, a protein receptor that downregulates the immune system.

900001167.name: Lokivetmab
900001167.description: Lokivetmab, trade name Cytopoint, is a monoclonal antibody used to treat atopic dermatitis in dogs.

900001295.name: Muromonab-CD3
900001295.description: Muromonab-CD3 (brand name Orthoclone OKT3, marketed by Janssen-Cilag) is an immunosuppressant medication given to reduce acute rejection in people with organ transplants.

900001423.name: Olokizumab
900001423.description: Olokizumab sold under the name Artlegia, is an immunosuppressive drug, used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and COVID-19.

900001551.name: Pidilizumab
900001551.description: Pidilizumab is a monoclonal antibody being developed by Medivation for the treatment of cancer and infectious diseases.

900001679.name: Ponezumab
900001679.description: Ponezumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

900001807.name: Romosozumab
900001807.description: Romosozumab, sold under the brand name Evenity ( ih-VENN-ih-tee or with the pin-pen merger, ih-VINN-ih-tee), is a medication used to treat osteoporosis.

900001935.name: Sulodexide
900001935.description: Sulodexide, traded as Aterina, is a highly purified mixture of glycosaminoglycans composed of heparan sulfate and dermatan sulfate .

900002063.name: Trastuzumab emtansine
900002063.description: Trastuzumab emtansine, sold under the brand name Kadcyla, is an antibody-drug conjugate consisting of the humanized monoclonal antibody trastuzumab covalently linked to the cytotoxic agent DM1.
